summary.text: PC is polycarbonate. Makers sell it for prototypes, tooling and heat-resistant technical parts. It is amorphous as printed, so it softens at its glass transition: its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 119 °C. On the H2C it prints with a standard nozzle, and makers warn of moisture absorption and ask for drying, but several products ask for more bed and chamber heat than the H2C gives.
